summary: Added an explicit bounded multiline regex record mode. The scanner accumulates one complete file record across reader blocks, enforces a 1 MiB original-byte ceiling before regex execution, evaluates unterminated EOF records, and preserves match-start line coordinates without changing the default physical-line path.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning Search source, tests, Search documentation and W07-S04 evidence were changed. The ignored local campaign state was not staged. No sibling repository, SQL/XML surface, release, publication or installation was modified.
implementation.recordMode: SearchRecordMode.BoundedMultiline is an explicit internal regex request mode. It treats one nonempty file as one complete record including LF characters; the default remains SearchRecordMode.PhysicalLine.
implementation.boundedRead: Mapped readers enforce 1,048,576 original bytes using decoder coordinates. Already-decoded readers enforce the selected encoding's byte count. The scanner checks the bound before appending each read block and before regex execution, with no arbitrary overlap or truncation.
implementation.coordinatePolicy: Multiline match spans use absolute decoded positions, physical line number and UTF-16 column for the match start. Lossless byte spans and W07-S03 capture spans reuse the existing full-record coordinate mapping.
implementation.completionPolicy: Nonempty unterminated EOF records are evaluated; empty files produce no record. Existing cancellation, typed overflow/read errors, sink row units and output lifecycle remain in force.

gateResults.evidence: The exact owning-repository Release suite exited 0 with 21 projects, 1,446 discovered, 1,412 passed, 0 failed and 34 expected skips; the focused Search suite exited 0 with 162 discovered, 159 passed, 0 failed and 3 expected platform-conditional skips.

The separate ownership review approved explicit mode selection, complete-record accumulation, byte bounds, coordinates, EOF behavior, cancellation and sink compatibility; exact commands, tool versions, source/artifact hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are recorded and verified during post-commit finalization.
Focused tests cover cross-buffer multiline matching, byte-limit rejection, unterminated EOF processing and zero-width final-boundary behavior.

Multiline behavior is an explicit internal record mode; the default physical-line contract and public two-argument literal constructors remain unchanged, with no silent fallback or invented public transport.

The complete record is bounded before regex execution, reader-block buffers are not retained, cancellation is checked around reads and matching, and existing typed read/resource/output lifecycle behavior is preserved.

knownLimitations: BoundedMultiline treats one nonempty file as one record and caps it at 1,048,576 original bytes; explicit delimiter/framing modes and larger or unbounded records remain future work.
The regex mode is an internal foundation; this scope does not add a public SQL/XML multiline constructor or many-pattern transport.
Multiline match line and column identify the physical line containing the match start; matching-file, count and line sinks retain their existing row-unit semantics.
The repository-wide suite retains 31 existing expected skips and 3 platform-conditional symlink skips; no package was published, pushed, released or installed.
